SELECT
FROM store s WHERE s.deleted = 0
AND s.status = #{q.status}
AND ( s.store_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR s.store_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR s.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR s.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY s.status DESC, s.id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(s.status = 1), 0) AS normal, COALESCE(SUM(s.status = 0), 0) AS disabled, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle v WHERE v.deleted = 0 AND v.store_id IN (SELECT id FROM store WHERE deleted = 0)) AS vehicle_total, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) FROM lease_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'WAIT_PAY') AND o.create_time >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')) AS month_revenue FROM store s WHERE s.deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lease_order WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lease_order WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND deleted = 0 AND status IN ('WAIT_PICKUP', 'IN_USE', 'WAIT_RETURN', 'OVERDUE')
